notes: Global South is a PRIORITY, not a filter: every country stays in the ranking.
opportunity = SI + income_bonus + novelty_bonus. SI (pure physical similarity) is always reported unchanged next to it.
Bonuses are additive points on the 0-100 SI scale, so a priority site can only overtake a site whose SI is at most `bonus` points higher. A clearly better analog in a high-income country still wins.
Bonuses apply only to candidates with SI >= min_si_for_bonus, so a weak analog is never promoted just because of where it is.
Income groups: World Bank classification (LIC/LMC/UMC/HIC), fetched by `python -m analog_atlas.cli fetch-income`.

novelty.notes: Research-attention layer (publications / field campaigns near the site). Not wired yet: every site gets 0 until the attention dataset exists.
